title: Gaze-Aware AI: Mathematical modeling of epistemic experience of the Marginalized for Human-Computer Interaction & AI Systems
reasoning: The paper extensively uses and evaluates concepts from epistemology and hermeneutics, specifically 'epistemic injustice' and 'hermeneutical injustice' (Fricker). It also grounds its framework in moral and social philosophy, citing MacIntyre's work on virtue and Sartre's ethics, to model the experience of marginalized groups in AI systems.
